title: ebInterface 6.1: the Austrian e-invoice the federal portal takes
source: ebInterface 6.1 of 25 August 2022, schemas/ebInterface6p1/Invoice.xsd (SHA-256 8c736ca0953c). The federal portal erechnung.gv.at takes ebInterface and UBL (Peppol BIS), not CII, under the e-Rechnungsverordnung (BGBl. II Nr. 505/2012); a federal buyer's order number is the OrderID. Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: The ebInterface 6.1 schema accepts the Austrian invoice or credit memo beside the page; skipped when it is not installed.
